identification: Rustic Tasmanian timber (described as depression era) two-door plank cupboard, old red paint, rough boards with iron strap/T hinges, three internal shelves, flat plank top with loose red-painted batten. Looks like a primitive farmhouse/kitchen or pantry cupboard, 169x137x66 cm. Description notes some borer. No maker marks.

entries.note: Painted kauri pine 2 door cupboard with adjustable shelving; neater, likely smaller piece. Paid locally: what we might pay, not a resale price. Local database hit.
